description: What an app process may create in its own data directory, OpenHarmony vs Android. Queried from the loaded kernel policy, not inferred from source.
method: write '<scon> <tcon> <class_index>' to /sys/fs/selinux/access and decode the allowed/auditdeny vectors (tool: probes/avq.c)

oh.board: OpenHarmony 6.1.0.31, arm64, SELinux enforcing policy as loaded

source_rules.fifo_granted_only_on_parent: sepolicy/ohos_policy/bundlemanager/bundle_framework/system/installs.te:199 allow hap_domain data_app_el2_file:fifo_file { create read write open lock unlink map setattr getattr rename }
source_rules.lnk_file_neverallow: sepolicy/base/public/hap_domain.te neverallow hap_domain ~{ tmpfs_data_file dev_file ... data_user_file hmdfs ... }:lnk_file *

fifo_file.fix: allow hap_domain normal_hap_data_file_attr:fifo_file { create read write open lock unlink map setattr getattr rename }; (no neverallow in hap_domain.te blocks it)

lnk_file.fix: neverallow'd for hap_domain on app data; needs a libc-level emulation of symlink(), not a policy rule

oh.workaround_without_policy_change: label the staged app-data tree data_app_el2_file: kernel grants normal_hap dir/file/fifo_file/sock_file there (still no lnk_file)

android.source_rule: system/sepolicy/private/untrusted_app_all.te:37 allow untrusted_app_all app_data_file:{ lnk_file sock_file fifo_file } create_file_perms;
